response.description:
Mistral Large 3, a frontier-class open-weight model with Apache 2.0 licensing, is now available in Microsoft Foundry on Azure. This model delivers enterprise-grade reliability, long-context comprehension, and multimodal reasoning—making it ideal for production assistants, retrieval-augmented applications, agentic systems, and multimodal workflows.Key Capabilities:Highly reliable instruction followingExtended context support for long documents and multi-turn conversationsStrong multimodal reasoning (text, images, diagrams)Stable, predictable performance for enterprise workloadsFully open and exportable for hybrid or on-premises deploymentWhy it matters:
Mistral Large 3 sets a new benchmark for open models, combining frontier-level capability, reproducible results, and worldwide availability without regional restrictions. Organizations can fine-tune, customize, and deploy the model across cloud, edge, or sovereign environments with no attribution requirements.Pricing:Input: $0.50 per 1M tokensOutput: $1.50 per 1M tokensDeployment: Global Standard (West US 3)Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Mistral Large 3 in Foundry
